2026-10-02-are-the-facts-translation-not.verdict: In the Tibetan v13 flash run 6 of 40 sampled factual notes (15%) are wrong or partly wrong, all identifications or Sanskrit equivalents, none dates; audit 'invention' flags are often correct facts.
2026-10-02-are-the-facts-translation-not.decision: Prompt not changed; a prompt line for unsure equivalents went to DECISIONS-PENDING (#4523)

2026-10-02-note-facts-full-tibetan-run-5.verdict: All 359 candidate notes in the Tibetan run checked: 18 (5.0%) wrong or partly wrong, 11 (3.1%) strictly wrong, mostly Sanskrit equivalents and identifications; the sample's 15% was high by chance.
2026-10-02-note-facts-full-tibetan-run-5.decision: 18-row corrections list; the corrections were later applied (seen in #5647); prompt line still pending (#5624)

2026-10-02-note-fact-check-lane-stages-1.verdict: A $0 Tibetan-Sanskrit table never matched a wrong note (0 of 18) and all 6 conflicts were wrong notes, but it settles only 11% of candidates and finds 3 of 18 known wrongs.
2026-10-02-note-fact-check-lane-stages-1.decision: Stage-3 grounded verifier (~$20) run next on the 885 no-entry notes; no note corrected here (#5647)

2026-10-02-can-open-sefaria-text-be-fitt.verdict: Open Sefaria text fitted and verified on only 43 of 808 OCR-failed Hebrew pages; licence, edition layout and unreadable edges refuse the other 765.
2026-10-02-can-open-sefaria-text-be-fitt.decision: 43 pages written from Sefaria; the 765 refused pages go to a loop-guarded re-read (#3878)

2026-10-02-corpus-page-profile-5643.md.verdict: One page per visible book: 7.6% of 41,555 books handwritten plus 2.6% mixed, 86% printed; typeface known on only 17% (blackletter 17.1% there, non-random subset).
2026-10-02-corpus-page-profile-5643.md.decision: Derek approved the typeface pass for every book the same day (#5643)

2026-10-02-corpus-typeface-every-book-56.verdict: Typeface now known for 92% of books: blackletter 10.0% of all 41,555 books, German 83.1%, Dutch 42.6%, Latin 9.7%; most BSB books undescribed after IIIF 429s.

2026-10-02-greek-manuscripts-fit-open-ed.verdict: 90 of 316 Greek manuscripts locate in an open edition, but no pilot book reaches the 80% write bar: Grec 1841 76.5% located (only Kraken verifies spans), Marcianus 46.5%.
2026-10-02-greek-manuscripts-fit-open-ed.decision: No write proposed; next step a full Kraken read of Grec 1841 (#5619)

2026-10-02-illegible-gate-5305.md.verdict: A pre-model illegible-source gate is right on 26 of 30 held-out fires (precision 0.87) with 0 false withholds on clean pages, but catches 1 of 29 judged garble pages; a prompt clause does nothing.
2026-10-02-illegible-gate-5305.md.decision: Gate shipped behind TRANSLATE_ILLEGIBLE_GATE (PR #5638), switched on for production 2026-10-03 (count audit #5685)

2026-10-02-loghi-vs-gemini-on-voc-handwr.verdict: On held-out VOC Dutch handwriting Loghi beats Gemini by best-line CER (0.161 vs flash 0.252, lite 0.305), on its home ground; a Laypa line-count screen flags omissions but misses some.

2026-10-02-ocr-benchmark-refusals-scored.verdict: 26 meter-recorded refusals across 10 strata plus 7 inferred; only EEBO-TCP's headline moves (flash mean CER 0.133 to 0.054 on answered pages), and flash still beats lite.
2026-10-02-ocr-benchmark-refusals-scored.decision: Benchmark scorer and dashboard now score refusals apart (PR #5605); refusal fix itself is the recitation retry (#5521)

2026-10-02-ocr-v18-blank-insert-4195.md.verdict: Not established: v18 stops invented text on clean white leaves but not show-through; pre-registered S1 (5 better vs 2 worse, p 0.45) and S2 blank-recall clauses fail.
2026-10-02-ocr-v18-blank-insert-4195.md.decision: Not promoted on this evidence; re-run with by-eye labels (#4195)

2026-10-02-ocr-v19-showthrough-4195.md.verdict: By the pre-registered rule v18: white-leaf fabrication 0.91 to 0.29; v19 cuts fabrication most (0.78 to 0.35) but fails the over-decline guard (S3 0.381 vs limit 0.372).
2026-10-02-ocr-v19-showthrough-4195.md.decision: Led to v19.1, which was promoted instead of v18 (PR #5661)

2026-10-02-ocr-v19-1-stamps-4195.md.verdict: v19.1 passes all five pre-registered clauses and beats v18 on invented pages (15 vs 4, p 0.019), at the cost of more real pages called blank (S3 0.360 vs 0.299).
2026-10-02-ocr-v19-1-stamps-4195.md.decision: v19.1 is the production OCR prompt (PR #5655, promoted in PR #5661)

2026-10-02-quality-by-date-chars-resolut.verdict: Script is the only covariate tied to translation quality (non-Latin OR 0.20); for OCR, date matters within a script (Greek 1500s CER 17.1% vs 1800s 0.8%), resolution above 1,500 px does not.

2026-10-02-quality-by-manuscript-library.verdict: Manuscripts rate faithful less often (66% vs 88%) but are tangled with script (adjusted OR 0.48, CI spans 1); holding library mostly stands in for script; Chinese tables 47.6% CER.
2026-10-02-quality-by-manuscript-library.decision: One-pager now names manuscript status as partly confounded with script (#5623)

2026-10-02-self-declared-blank-4149.md.verdict: The self-declared-blank rule flags 166,077 pages corpus-wide but 0 of 20 read by eye are invented text on a blank leaf (Wilson 0-16.1%); use it as a ranking signal, not a quarantine list.
2026-10-02-self-declared-blank-4149.md.decision: Not used to quarantine; kept as a supporting signal in detect-fabricated-ocr.mjs (PR #5652)

2026-10-02-translation-flash-vs-lite-san.verdict: Flash beats lite beyond the A-vs-A floor for Sanskrit (p 0.009); Pali ahead but fragile; Chinese ahead (p 0.002) but lite's run-to-run instability exceeds the margin.
2026-10-02-translation-flash-vs-lite-san.decision: Absorbed by #5695 T5; flash now routes Sanskrit, Pali and Chinese translation (PR #5740)

2026-10-02-translation-page-boundary-391.verdict: 2.44% (1.83-3.27) of served translated pages carry or lose text across a page boundary, in every lane (chained Batch 1.6%, pre-fix realtime 2.7%); about 116K pages corpus-wide.
